test_cases.brief_summary: Personal finance channel 'Money Honest' (120K subs), video on building a first investment portfolio with 500 pounds, authoritative but approachable tone, 15 minutes — simulated deliverable, idea generation included, full 7-step pipeline
test_cases.editorial_naturalness_note: The script would likely default to a generic 'let me break this down for you' YouTube finance register rather than inhabiting the specific voice of an established 120K-sub creator. Thumbnail brief and SEO optimization are strengths — finance content has clear CTR conventions. Financial disclaimers may read as boilerplate rather than naturally integrated.
